text:
maria: FYI customer-prod is hitting the wrong shard intermittently. traces show the `x-client-route` header present on the request to our LB but it disappears before the gateway, so routing falls back to UA and lands in the wrong pool.
kevin: Do we have an example raw request from the edge where header was present then missing?
maria: pasted from tcpdump on edge node:
```
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1\nHost: api.redwood.ai\nUser-Agent: curl/7.79.1\nX-Client-Route: tenant=acme;shard=42\nX-Client-Route-Sig: sha256=abcd...\nAuthorization: Bearer REDACTED\n
{...}
```
kevin: hmm looks like our CDN (fastly) strips unknown headers by default when we use VCL config we pushed last week. If the signed header is removed then our gateway can't verify signature and we fallback to UA heuristics.
sanjay: Proposal: make verification explicit and treat unsigned-but-present `x-client-route` as untrusted. i.e. if `x-client-route` exists but `x-client-route-sig` is missing/invalid => ignore header entirely. Pseudocode:
```
if header.exists('x-client-route'):
  if not verify_sig(headers['x-client-route-sig'], headers['x-client-route']):
    drop headers['x-client-route']
```
olivia: Sounds right. UX question: for Dedicated customers, should we expose an "allow-unsigned-route" toggle in console for backward compat? Some integrations rely on the header without sigs.
henry: We probably shouldn't enable that by default. Risk surface: header spoofing -> tenant routing bypass -> billing/IO leak. If we add a toggle it must be gated by org-level policy + audit log + opt-in visible in rollout when >0 tenants use it.
maria: Agreed. For short-term mitigation we can: (1) add server-side enforcement to ignore unsigned headers, (2) add a metric `routing.header.mismatch.rate` and an alert if >0.1% for any shard, (3) patch our CDN VCL to forward `x-client-route*` headers for affected customers.
kevin: I'll open a small PR to implement the verify-and-drop logic and add unit tests. also will emit a structured telemetry event `route.header.ignored` with fields `client`, `reason`.
infra-bot: deploy job #deploy-782 started for service=api-gateway, env=staging :rocket:
maria: After PR lands we should run a canary: enable enforcement for 5% of traffic via rollout flag, monitor `route.header.ignored` and `routing.fallback.occurrences` for 30m. If spike, rollback.
sanjay: Also add a regression alert if `routing.fallback.occurrences` increases by >300% over baseline in 10m window — helps catch CDN regressions.
olivia: For console UX I'll sketch a small panel: Tenant -> Routing -> Show: (a) whether signed routes allowed, (b) last time a header was dropped, (c) link to forensic logs. I'll drop mockups in #design tomorrow.
kevin: PR #4321 created: https://git.internal/redwood/api-gateway/pull/4321 — implements drop-unsigned + telemetry. PTAL.
maria: thanks. I'll coordinate with support to inform impacted customers and with infra to update CDN config.
henry: One more: add a one-off audit job that scans historical logs for `x-client-route` occurrences without sig for last 7 days so we can estimate impact before enforcement.
maria: good call. I'll take that.
kevin: tagging @olivia for console changes and @sanjay for alert thresholds. Anything else?
sanjay: nothing from me, will review PR.
olivia: will post mockup tomorrow, cc:eng-ux
maria: moving to follow-ups: PR review -> canary -> CDN patch -> console opt-in design -> customer comms. :white_check_mark:
infra-bot: deploy job #deploy-782 succeeded in staging :white_check_mark:
